Crookes and Crosspool — Sheffield, United Kingdom

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

South Yorkshire Police recorded 187 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 3.6 per 1,000 residents a month, the 26th highest rate of Sheffield's 28 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (5), shoplifting (3), burglary (2); the evening/night score by anti social behaviour (16), violent crime (14), public order (4). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Crookes and Crosspool safe?

Wandroz currently rates Crookes and Crosspool in Sheffield as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from South Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Crookes and Crosspool safe at night?

At night, Crookes and Crosspool is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Crookes and Crosspool a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Crookes and Crosspool's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Sheffield) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches Sheffield, not Crookes and Crosspool specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.
